The house number and road / street.
The postcode / zip code.
The town name.
The What3Words system for your location.

If you are traveling on a bus this process can be useful to indicate when you’re nearing where you want to alight.

3/ If you ‘double tap’ with two fingers, it reads out all 4 lines of information.

1/ To view the map, just swipe horizontally either from Left to Right or Right to Left.
2/ Swiping Up with 2 fingers speeds up the speech and Down slows it down. These rates of speech are remembered when you open the app.

Shake Gesture:-
